lore.intro:
The chapel deck. Folded.
Six rooms around one. Or one room
around six. The count depends on the walker.

terminals.text:
SERMON, UNDELIVERED
They ask: is the station haunted?
No. A haunting is a place remembering.
This is a place being remembered —
by something on the other side.

[TRANSLATION CONFIDENCE 8%]
six were sent. six return, always six.
the seventh count is a mistake in the counting,
not a seventh room. we filed it that way for a
long time. the filing is also how the room first
appeared. we do not file it that way now, and
the room has not gone.

[TRANSLATION CONFIDENCE 19%]
students were walked here blind, on purpose,
early. counting the doors and losing the count
was the whole of the lesson. you cannot fear a
direction you have already used to find your way
home once.

[TRANSLATION CONFIDENCE 6%]
we did not name them once we understood them.
naming a thing is agreeing it has one shape. the
closest word left in any of our tongues
translates, roughly, as 'the un-arriving guest.'
